image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated within a church or cathedral interior. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights and diameters, arranged in a symmetrical facade with gilded decorative elements. The lower section includes the console area with visible keyboards and stop mechanisms, set against a backdrop of carved wood and stone architecture.
